name: rosetta-anagrams
code:
use default

sorted_letters(word: string) -> string =>
    string(word |> sort() |> collect_array())

let sets = MAP[string, LIST[string]]()

for word in IO.File.read_all_lines("unixdict.txt") do
    let key = sorted_letters(word)

    if !sets.contains_key(key) then
        sets[key] = LIST()
    fi

    sets[key].add(word)
od

let largest =
    sets.values
        |> reduce(0, (n, words) => System.Math.max(n, words.count))

sets.values
    |> filter(words => words.count == largest)
    |> each(words => write_line(words |> join(" ")))

        |> reduce(0, (n, words) => System.Math.max(n, words.count))

sets.values
